title: User Login with Valid Credentials
steps: Navigate to the login page of the application.
Enter a valid username into the username input field.
Enter the corresponding valid password into the password input field.
expected_result: The user is successfully logged in and redirected to their dashboard.

title: Search for a product by name
steps: Navigate to the homepage of the e-commerce website.
Locate the search bar at the top of the page.
Click on the search bar to activate it.
Type the name of the product you are looking for into the search bar.
Press the 'Enter' key or click on the search icon/button to initiate the search.
Wait for the search results to load.
expected_result: The search results page displays a list of products that match the name entered in the search bar. Relevant products, if available, should appear prominently on the page.

title: Add a product to cart and checkout
steps: Search for a product using the search bar.
Select a product from the search results.
Click on the 'Add to Cart' button.
Review the cart items and click on 'Checkout'.
Select a payment method and provide payment details.
Review the order summary and confirm the purchase.
expected_result: The product is successfully added to the cart, and the user completes the purchase after checking out.
